name: Le Petit Nice
address: 17 rue des Braves (Anse de Maldormé), 13007 Marseille
dinnerNoteFr: Menu dégustation le plus long (autres menus dès 230 €)
lunchNote: Maldormé lunch menu: amuse-bouche, 4 savoury courses, 2 desserts (the €310–€390 menus also at lunch Thu–Sat; the €490 menu is dinner only)

stay.name: Le Petit Nice

packages.name: Séjour escale gourmande
packages.includes: A night for two in a sea-view executive room with breakfast, the Menu Passedat for two at lunch or dinner in the three-star restaurant (drinks extra), soft drinks from the minibar, wellness area and sea-water pool
packages.when: Monday to Saturday; price varies by season (1,140 in low season, 1,320 mid, 1,520 high)

packages.name: Séjour de rêve à Malmousque
packages.includes: A night for two in a junior suite or suite with breakfast, the Menu Passedat for two at lunch or dinner with drinks included (not the aperitif), soft drinks from the minibar, wellness area and sea-water pool

stay.note: A five-star hotel of two villas and 16 rooms on the rocks above the sea.
